summary.text: Daniel Zolnikov is a Republican state senator who represents Montana State Senate District 22, took office in January 2023 after serving in the Montana House from 2013 to 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A consultant by profession, he holds University of Montana degrees in business and an M.B.A.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Zolnikov earned a B.S. in business administration, information systems, marketing and management from the University of Montana, Missoula, in 2010 and an M.B.A. from the University of Montana in 2019.

His career experience includes working as a management consultant at Zolnikov Consulting, as a sales and marketing manager at a Billings small business startup, and as an implementation consultant at Fast Enterprises.
Zolnikov served in the Montana House of Representatives from 2013 to 2021 and was sworn into the State Senate on January 2, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Business, Labor and Economic Affairs Committee and the Senate Natural Resources Committee.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary; Cari Olson and Elijah Tidswell are listed as nonpartisan write-in candidates in the general election.
